title: Kling AI Announces Kling 4.0 Flash Fully Open, Deeply Integrated into Professional Film and TV Workflows

content_html:
Significant progress has been made in the field of AI video generation. Kling AI has officially announced that the highly anticipated Kling4.0Flash is now fully open to all users worldwide. As a core version built for high-frequency creation and cost-effectiveness, the model not only supports access through the official website and API, but also further opens up a multi-dimensional access ecosystem, fully empowering creators in their daily video production.

Deep Integration of Multi-Platform Access and Professional Software Ecosystems

In terms of ecosystem compatibility, Kling4.0Flash demonstrates a high degree of openness and flexibility. In addition to the conventional web interface and API, this update officially supports convenient access through MCP, CLI, and various AI plugins.

Even more notably, to seamlessly fit the actual working habits of professional film, TV, and advertising editors, creators can now directly use the powerful generation capabilities of Kling4.0Flash in mainstream professional software such as Adobe Photoshop, Premiere Pro, and After Effects through the built-in Kling plugin. This breaks down the barriers between standalone AI software and traditional post-production tools, making the entire workflow from asset generation to fine-grained editing more efficient and smooth.

With the full rollout of this version, whether it is the frequent daily creative iterations of independent media creators or the rapid ideation and batch output of professional commercial projects, all will see unprecedented efficiency upgrades.
